crossRefs.note: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
translations.bsb: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
translations.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
translations.asv: Know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.
